I MISSED QUESTION TIME!!! ARGHEHRHGHERHGHDF

Lets recap some of the points I found most interesting:

1) People like Bunker AZ and Unity not getting stand alone Nemmys really throws all of our speculation about the next 2 expansion formats into the trash. It is now highly unlikely that either of them will be "standard" expansion formats (2 hero 2 enviro 4 villain).

2) I had speculated for a long time that we might see some current villain-turned-hero decks. Glad that is proven to be true. Lillian Corvus was the big one for me. It would make senese that she wouldnt keep the Matriarch name. But not keep the nemmy symbol? Thats interesting for sure!

3) The villain team assembled in Setbacks High Risk Behavior would seem the most likely to be converted into the V5 format. It's cool that this format will be getting more plug ins.

4) Unity is absolutely related to CON. This is something a lot of us had suspected for a long time given the way CON talks in Chrono's bio.

5) Heartbreaker! I am almost positive this is the tentitive name me and Braith gave this character in our speculation threads. Pretty cool! He will probably be one of the top assasins of the ninja guild/Dragon Clans led by Zhu Long. Fixer/Operative/Zhu Long all sport matching dragon tattoos.

6) Thiago turns into Ra in Tactics. Common guys. This is all but the most sure fire speculation ever.

7) Expats father will turn up! I am betting its the guy with the black eye shown in the Sentinels deck and the guy she has a standoff with in her own deck. Honestly, who else could that guy be.
